title: At the café
somali: Cumar wuxuu joogaa maqaayad yar. Wuxuu fadhiistaa meel u dhow daaqadda. Wuxuu dalbadaa koob shaah ah iyo keeg yar. Shaahu waa kulul yahay. Keeggu waa macaan yahay. Cumar buug ayuu akhriyaa isagoo shaahiisa cabbaya. Laba doollar ayuu bixiyaa. Dabadeed guriga ayuu aadaa.
explanation: Omar is at a café. He sits near the window. He orders a cup of tea and a small cake. The tea is hot. The cake is sweet. Omar reads a book and drinks his tea. He pays two dollars. Then he goes home.
examples: window: the glass part of a wall where you can see outside
order: to ask for food or drink in a café

exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Daaqadda agteeda”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.explain: He orders tea and a small cake.
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Shaah iyo keeg yar”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.
Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “dollars”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

examplesSo: daaqad: qaybta muraayadda leh ee gidaarka oo bannaanka laga arko
dalbid: codsashada cunto ama cabitaan maqaayad

title: My school
somali: Magacaygu waa Xamdi. Waxaan dhigtaa dugsi weyn. Dugsigaygu wuxuu leeyahay labaatan fasal iyo hal maktabad. Waxaan bartaa Ingiriisi, xisaab iyo saynis. Macallinka aan ugu jeclahay waa Mudane Yuusuf. Dugsigu wuxuu bilaabmaa siddeedda subaxnimo wuxuuna dhammaadaa labada duhurnimo. Saaxiibkay ayaan lug kula aadaa dugsiga.
explanation: My name is Hana. I go to a big school. My school has twenty classrooms and one library. I study English, maths and science. My favourite teacher is Mr Yusuf. School starts at eight and finishes at two. I walk to school with my friend.
examples: library: a place with many books
favourite: the one you like best

exercises.promptSo: Imisa fasal ayaa dugsiga ku yaal?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Labaatan”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.
Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Laba-da”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: Hana walks to school with her... (one word)
exercises.promptSo: Hana dugsiga waxay la lugaysaa ... (hal eray).
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “friend”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

examplesSo: ugu jecel: qofka ama shayga aad kuwa kale uga jeceshahay
dhammaad: in wax la soo afjaro
